configurations.name: blackshear-pta-dev
configurations.//: Invokes the Node 22 binary directly on Astro's CLI entry. The project pins 22.22.3 in .node-version (Astro 7 requires >=22.12), but a launcher does not run fnm's use-on-cd hook, and going through npm does not help, since npm scripts resolve `node` from PATH and would still find the default Node 20. In a normal terminal, `cd` into the repo and `npm run dev` works fine.

configurations.name: blackshear-pta-worker
configurations.//: The real Workers runtime, which is the ONLY way to see /, /announcements/*, and /rss.xml since those render on demand out of D1 (PR #36) - astro preview serves files and those are not files any more. Run `npm run build` first, and `npm run db:migrate` once, or the D1 binding has no tables. Restart after every build: the build replaces dist/ underneath the running server.

configurations.name: blackshear-pta-preview
configurations.//: Serves the built output from ./dist on a second port, so it can run alongside `npm run dev` on 4321. Run `npm run build` first; this does not rebuild.
